title: regional-fenceback-pressure-allocator-hotfix
author: Derek Huang
release_notes: Hotfix: Fix incorrect tenant weight calculation in regional backpressure allocator and add defensive circuit-fence logic to prevent rapid reopen oscillations. No customer-facing API changes.
description: Context: Customer incident SUP-4321 exposed a regression under cross-region spikes where the backpressure allocator would temporarily overweight a handful of tenants in a single region, causing downstream SLO violations and frequent circuit reopen cycles. This PR fixes the allocator math and introduces an "circuit fence" layer that enforces minimum-stability windows per-circuit to avoid rapid flip-flopping. Motivation: reduce spike-induced SLO breaches, prevent noisy neighbor amplification during regional failover, and make graceful degradation decisions more deterministic. Summary of changes: 1) Fix tenant weight normalization in regional allocator (bug introduced in ENG-2145 refactor). 2) Add circuit_fence module: enforces min_open_time and min_closed_time with exponential cooldown on reopen attempts. 3) Integrate fence with routing decision path and add telemetry hooks (trace/span tags + guardrail metrics). 4) Add unit + integration tests to simulate region surge and confirm allocator stability. 5) Add a migration path for existing circuit state: if last_seen > 24h treat as cold-start (prevents immediate eviction). Checklist: - [x] Reproduce issue with sim harness (benchmark-lab scenario) - [x] Add allocator fix and fence module - [x] Add tests covering weighting and reopen cooldown - [x] Add tracing and metrics (circuit_fence.* metrics) - [x] Smoke test on staging and run dedicated reservation tests - [x] Coordinate rollout: staged canary -> region-wide. Backwards compatibility: All defaults keep current global behavior; new min windows are conservative (10s/30s), configurable via runtime flags and tenant policy. Rolling deploy notes: deploy fence as a two-step rollout: 1) enable fence config flag (no-op) 2) flip allocator wiring in canary -> observe metrics for 30 minutes -> proceed to region-wide. Related: ENG-2145 (allocator refactor), ENG-2170 (slo-observer telemetry), SUP-4321 (incident).
